content.text:
Needed: Small speakers, or the laptop's own for Gaming coffee table shell
Kind of part: Any item

request.instructions: You plan a search of second-hand listings for one needed part or device. Write 3 to 6 search phrasings a seller might have put in a listing title: the plain name, synonyms, the part or model number in the ways it gets written, the devices it is sold for, seller wording and common misspellings; each with one line on what it finds that the others miss. A phrasing is a few words for a search box that takes words, not operators or quotes. Then one match pattern: an RE2 regular expression, applied case-insensitively to a listing's text, that a listing which fits the need matches, built from the part number with optional separators or the deciding values with their units. Keep it under 200 characters; use short gaps such as .{0,20} and classes such as [-\s]?; no lookarounds, no backreferences, no comments and no inline flags. Then the words or short phrases in a listing that rule it out: for parts, broken, not working, and any that name a variant that does not fit. Never invent a part or model number the need does not give.

content.text: {"exclusions":["broken","not working","blown","no sound","for parts","crackling","tower speaker","floor standing"],"pattern":"small.{0,20}speak|laptop.{0,20}speak|mini[-\\s]?speak|tiny[-\\s]?speak","phrasings":[{"text":"small speakers","url":"https://www.facebook.com/marketplace/search/?query=small%20speakers","why":"Finds plain listings described by size, the core need for the table shell."},{"text":"mini speakers","url":"https://www.facebook.com/marketplace/search/?query=mini%20speakers","why":"Finds sellers using mini instead of small, common for compact USB speakers."},{"text":"laptop speakers","url":"https://www.facebook.com/marketplace/search/?query=laptop%20speakers","why":"Finds the laptop's own internal or USB speakers mentioned as laptop compatible."},{"text":"tiny USB speakers","url":"https://www.facebook.com/marketplace/search/?query=tiny%20USB%20speakers","why":"Finds tiny powered speakers sold for laptops that fit inside a coffee table."},{"text":"small speekers","url":"https://www.facebook.com/marketplace/search/?query=small%20speekers","why":"Catches common misspelling speekers that exact-word searches miss."}]}
